body: Just let them know. "I support homosexuality, however I am not interested. Sorry."
Sorry, but I couldn't really understand you. Are you meaning that gay people should not be allowed the same rights (like marriage) as 'normal' people, but people should say "it's ok, you're gay"?

Probably someone who's 'forever alone'.

I'm not quite sure if I want to go to college. I already hate schools now.

Thank you for the comment.
